subdomain.name: Accounts
subdomain.capability: Onboarding, maintenance, overdraft limits and state lifecycle of customer deposit and commercial accounts, including holds.
subdomain.why_distinct: Owns the account state machine, overdraft approval and hold lifecycle, which change independently of ledger bookkeeping or payment routing.

ubiquitous_language.definition: IBAN or internal format identifier of a deposit account.
Savings, Checking, High-Yield or Commercial account held by a verified customer.
Individually approved overdraft limit based on customer risk tier and capped by regulation.
Also Lien or Reservation Hold: balance reservation placed on an account pending settlement.

bounded_contexts.name: Account Lifecycle
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Manage deposit account opening, state transitions, overdraft limits and holds.
invariants: Account must belong to a verified Customer profile before opening
Account state transitions follow PROVISIONAL -> ACTIVE -> FROZEN -> TERMINATED
FROZEN account cannot originate outgoing debits but may accept incoming credits
Overdraft limit must be individually approved by risk tier and not exceed regulatory caps
Account cannot be TERMINATED with non-zero balance or pending unsettled holds

assumptions.item: Customer profile verification is performed outside this description (customer/KYC context not described).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: A Customer context may be needed; Accounts only consumes verified status.

assumptions.item: Hold requests come from Payments; hold ownership assigned to Accounts per the description.
Non-zero balance check on closure needs balance from General Ledger.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Cross-context read of balance; ownership of balance stays in General Ledger.
